cpi_usd.definition: Spend divided by installs from a tap, of the same week.
cpi_usd.title: Cost per install

impressions.definition: Times an ad of the app was shown in search results.
impressions.title: Ad impressions

installs.definition: Installs Apple Ads attributes to a tap on an ad.
installs.title: Installs from a tap

spend_usd.definition: What Apple Ads charged for the week, in US dollars.
spend_usd.title: Spend

taps.definition: Times a shown ad was tapped.
taps.title: Taps

ttr.definition: Taps divided by ad impressions of the same week.
ttr.title: Tap-through rate

failed_requests.definition: Every request in the ledger that failed, up to that day.
failed_requests.title: Failed requests so far

observations.definition: Every row in the rank ledger up to that day.
observations.title: Observations

paired_keys.definition: Tracked keys with two reads that can be compared: same source, same depth, different days.
paired_keys.title: Keys with a comparable pair

unmeasurable_keys.definition: Keys whose latest answer is an empty result list.
unmeasurable_keys.title: Unmeasurable keys

deleted_within_1d.approximation: Counted only on devices that share analytics with developers: a sample, not a total and not a cohort.
deleted_within_1d.definition: Opt-in deletions that happened within one day of the install.
deleted_within_1d.title: Deleted within a day

deletions_per_100.approximation: Counted only on devices that share analytics with developers: a sample, not a total and not a cohort.
deletions_per_100.definition: Opt-in deletions for every hundred opt-in installs of the same week.
deletions_per_100.title: Deletions per 100 installs

optin_deletions.approximation: Counted only on devices that share analytics with developers: a sample, not a total and not a cohort.
optin_deletions.definition: Deletions of the app reported by the same opt-in devices.
optin_deletions.title: Deletions, opt-in devices

optin_installs.approximation: Counted only on devices that share analytics with developers: a sample, not a total and not a cohort.
optin_installs.definition: First installs reported by devices that share analytics with developers.
optin_installs.title: Installs, opt-in devices

ad_spend_usd.definition: What Apple Ads charged for the week, in US dollars.
ad_spend_usd.title: Apple Ads spend

net_cashflow_usd.definition: Proceeds minus Apple Ads spend for the week. Not profit: no other cost is in it.
net_cashflow_usd.title: Net cashflow

new_trials.definition: Free trials started in the week. A trial is not a paying customer.
new_trials.title: Trials started

proceeds_usd.definition: What the store pays out for the week's transactions, after its commission and taxes, in US dollars.
proceeds_usd.title: Proceeds

transactions.definition: Purchases and renewals that were paid for in the week.
transactions.title: Paid transactions

beyond.definition: Keys read and not found within the depth searched.
beyond.title: Beyond depth

errors.definition: Keys whose request failed that day: unknown, not absent.
errors.title: Failed requests

keys_read.definition: Tracked keys that got an answer that day: a position, or not found within the depth searched.
keys_read.title: Keys read

no_results.definition: Keys for which the search returned nothing at all, so they cannot say where the app stands.
no_results.title: No results

share_top10.definition: Keys in the top 10 divided by keys read that day.
share_top10.title: Share in the top 10

share_top30.definition: Keys at positions 1 to 30 divided by keys read that day.
share_top30.title: Share in the top 30

tracked_keys.definition: Non-brand keys the store had asked about by that day, read or not.
tracked_keys.title: Tracked keys

rating_average.definition: The mean of those star ratings, from 1 to 5.
rating_average.title: Average rating

ratings_count.definition: Star ratings the app holds at the moment of the read.
ratings_count.title: Ratings

reviews.definition: Reviews with text at the moment of the read.
reviews.title: Written reviews

reviews_unanswered.definition: Written reviews that have no developer reply.
reviews_unanswered.title: Unanswered reviews

first_downloads.definition: Downloads by accounts that never had the app before. Updates and re-downloads are left out.
first_downloads.title: First-time downloads

impression_cvr.definition: First-time downloads divided by impressions, both of the same week.
impression_cvr.title: Impressions that download

impressions.definition: Times the app was seen in the store on a unique device: in search results, on a chart, on the Today tab or on its own product page.
impressions.title: Impressions

page_cvr.definition: First-time downloads divided by product page views, both of the same week. Not a share of the page views: a download made straight from the search results has no page view, so this can pass 100%.
page_cvr.title: Downloads per page view

page_views.definition: Times the app's product page was opened on a unique device.
page_views.title: Product page views

view_rate.definition: Product page views divided by impressions, both of the same week.
view_rate.title: Impressions that open the page

active_subscriptions.definition: Paid subscriptions active at the moment of the read.
active_subscriptions.title: Active subscriptions

active_trials.definition: Free trials running at the moment of the read.
active_trials.title: Active trials

active_users_28d.definition: Users seen in the 28 days before the read.
active_users_28d.title: Active users, 28 days

mrr_usd.definition: Monthly recurring revenue as the subscription provider computes it, in US dollars.
mrr_usd.title: MRR

new_customers_28d.definition: Customers first seen in the 28 days before the read.
new_customers_28d.title: New customers, 28 days

revenue_28d_usd.definition: Gross revenue of the 28 days before the read, in US dollars.
revenue_28d_usd.title: Revenue, 28 days

decisions.definition: The newest entries of decisions.md dated on or before the day exported, newest first, as written. An entry is a `## <day> — <title>` heading and what follows it; one longer than the cap is cut at a line end and says so.
decisions.title: Decisions

reasoning.definition: The latest `Verdict reasoning` section of a hypothesis file, as written: the newest day in its heading wins, and an undated section loses to a dated one. Read as the file stands today, whatever day was exported.
reasoning.title: Verdict reasoning

report.definition: The newest cycle report of the store whose file name carries a day on or before the day exported, as written; one longer than the cap is cut at a line end and says so.
report.title: Latest cycle report
